nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is the ratio of S-doped SPAC to iodine used for the iodine doping process?
nodes.answer: The ratio of S-doped SPAC to iodine used for the iodine doping process is 1:2.
nodes.paragraph: In the second stage, sulphur doping was performed with sulfuric acid. A certain amount of SPAC (3 g) and 30 mL of sulfuric acid diluted with pure water at a 1:3 ratio was added to a conical flask [ 35]. This mixture was hydrothermally processed in an oven at 105 C for 24 h. After this process, the obtained sample was repeatedly washed with hot and cold pure water and was named S-doped SPAC. The third stage involves adding iodine to the S-doped SPAC sample by hydrothermal heating method. To achieve iodine doping, S-doped SPAC was mixed with iodine at a 1:2 ratio in a 30 mL aqueous solution. Heating and mixing were carried out via hydrothermal processing on a magnetic stirrer at 50 C for 6 h. Subsequently, the obtained sample was washed multiple times with pure water and dried in an oven at 80 C for 2 h. This sample was named iodine@S- doped SPAC. The production scheme of the iodine@ S-doped SPAC sample is presented in Fig. 1. 2.2 Material characterization XRD analyses were performed with a Philips X'pert device with a Cu-K source.

nodes.answer: The iodine doping process is conducted at 50°C.

nodes.question: What was the ratio of iodine@S-doped SPAC, graphite, and mineral oil used in the electrode preparation?
nodes.paragraph: Pt (MF- 1032, BASi) as the auxiliary electrode was available, and Ag/AgCI (3 M KCI, MF 1063) was available as the reference electrode. In the working electrode preparation for the super - capacitor, iodine@S-doped SPAC, graphite (conductivity enhancer) and mineral oil (binder) was used. lodine@S- doped SPAC, graphite and mineral oil ratios was 6:2:2, and the mixture turned into a paste, and then the carbon paste was manually pressed into the electrode (CPE, MF-2010). The amount of iodine@S-doped SPAC is 1.5 mg/cm2. To achieve more precise and reproducible results with the designed supercapacitor electrode, the surface was soaked in a supportive electrolyte environment for 3 h.
